7a1713d0168dbb413d74.text: {"body":"Thanks for getting in touch. I would like to hear more. Could you share the deliverables, fee, timeline, usage rights you have in mind? If you attached a brief, it did not come through, so please paste the key points in your reply."}

34c8ac17fe5f97559461.label: draft D-08 BrewBox

663acdd05957d1fe897b.label: draft D-09 AuralBuds
663acdd05957d1fe897b.text: {"body":"The fee of USD 800 for 1 Instagram reel works for me. My fee includes up to 3 months of paid‑ad usage. Perpetual usage would need to be priced separately. Can we keep usage to 3 months, or what budget do you have for the extended rights?"}
